_meta.units: spec coordinates: x = unity x (arena centre 0), y = unity y + 250 (Level.Ground); half sizes are AABB half extents
_meta.source: live Collider2D.bounds via CupheadRLBridge debug state, lockstep 1 tick/sample

tomb.note: Resolved: the tombstone has ONE CircleCollider2D (lossyScale 1). While moving it is r=100 centred at y_spec 310-340 (spans ~210-440), above standing peashots (y 64-104), so standing shots do 0 damage (tomb.damage_from_standing_shots, 10 s of walking+shooting under it). During the 'smash' clip the radius animates up to ~260 and the centre drops (min y -190), so the slam covers the ground; jumping shots or shots during the slam are what connect.
big.note: Big Goopy's body is the r=160 root circle at +133 y. When punching it throws its second root circle (r 80->110) up to ~550 u forward and animates a root BoxCollider2D (up to 217x27 half extents): both are reported as FIST.
small.note: Small Goopy's single root circle (r 80) stretches to r 170 and moves 390 u forward during punch_hold; ArmCollider (child box, up to 135x130 half) is the FIST.
